bio1: A multidisciplinary Creative Director with a *decade* spent turning high-level concepts into immersive visual narratives. My sweet spot sits where bold art direction meets technological evolution. Where the idea is sharp enough to *hold a room*, and the craft is precise enough to earn it.
bio2:
We live in a world of digital static, and cutting through it takes more than chasing trends. As an early adopter of *generative AI*, I've spent the last few years building workflows that let ideas move at the speed of the tools that make them, without losing the human touch of the work. Faster iteration, sharper concepts, more room to *play*. 
The tools change every month. The creative discipline doesn't.
bio3: From tech-forward stage environments for *global players* like TikTok and Microsoft to the quieter craft of shaping a single frame, I create physical and digital experiences that *leave a mark*.
